semantics.shared_scope: Complete system prefix + document, no question or answer enters scoring
semantics.allocation: NVIDIA default global bottom-k then per-layer across-head bottom-k; unequal head/layer budgets
semantics.protected: First4 shared-prefill tokens; final max(1,floor(2%*N)) if N<32000 else4096, scores set to1.0
semantics.budget_denominator: All36 layers *8 KV heads *shared-prefill tokens, including system prefix
semantics.private_history: Every question and generated token retained; original positions/causality
semantics.physical_cache: Dense reference with exact per-head masks, no physical compression or serving speed claim
semantics.chunked_prefill: Dense 1024-token chunks; no optimized author eviction-during-prefill path

qualification.gate_score_comparisons: Every shared-prefill chunk and layer against both upstream gate classes

author_postprefill_threshold_case.policy: Author post-prefill global score>threshold, system prefix outside budget; not optimized chunk-prefill-evict.

qualification.fullbudget_path: All-keep support bypasses added mask; unchanged original attention path
